text:
Priya (CS): heads-up Newbridge reported ~30% 500s on /v1/re-rank since 09:12 UTC after model swap. Customer is already in their SLA window, asking for ETA on mitigation. Logs show errors like `KVCache miss` and `out of memory` in pods. Can we triage ownership?

Dylan (Eng): on it. Any recent infra changes? model swap param?

Alex (Platform): I rolled the model variant at 09:10 to rdx-re-rank-v2-quant (autoscaler unchanged). No infra deploys. Sending link to perf dashboard: https://dash.redwood/in/abc123

Samir (Oncall): I'm on pager. I'll pull metrics and tail logs. Priya can you confirm if they can take temporary throttling?

Priya (CS): Customer agreed to short throttling and fallback to previous model if that helps. Wants ETA within 45m.

Dylan (Eng): Plan: (1) route Newbridge traffic to rdx-re-rank-v1 via route override, (2) add rate cap 50r/s for their key, (3) produce a small patch fixing KV cache miss. Who will do routing change?

Alex (Platform): I can apply route override in console and patch the ingress rule. I'll need Dylan to approve route name and a simple curl to validate. I can do 1&2 in ~10m. Dylan want to own the patch?

Dylan (Eng): I'll open a minimal PR to disable prefix-KV caching for re-rank in v2 to prevent OOM, targeting hotfix branch. PR: https://git.redwood/r/re-rank/pulls/542 (WIP).

CI-Bot: build #542 failed — tests: model_integration_tests (timeout).

Samir (Oncall): we can still do routing override manually to stop customer 500s. Alex go ahead once Dylan confirms.

Alex (Platform): Preparing route override: `POST /admin/routes/override { "customer":"newbridge", "model":"rdx-re-rank-v1", "duration":"2h" }` Will run after Dylan says go.

Dylan (Eng): Go ahead. I'll slam the PR later. Also adding temporary metrics emit: `metric('re_rank_v2_oom',1)` around kv path.

Priya (CS): Please ping me once rollback/routing done so I can tell customer. They want a followup call in 30m.

Alex (Platform): override applied at 09:23 UTC. Verified 200->99% on /v1/re-rank for Newbridge (tail: `200 OK`).

Samir (Oncall): Monitoring p99 and error rate; will keep an eye on CPU/GPU OOMs. Dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/mon/xyz

Dylan (Eng): PR updated, tests flaky but patch is trivial. I'll merge to hotfix on approval window in 30m. Plan to roll v2 back in staged canary later once cache patch verified.

Priya (CS): Customer informed and relieved for now. They'll hold escalations if we give 4h post-patch runway.

Alex (Platform): ownership: Dylan = patch & merge, Alex = routing & throttles, Samir = realtime monitoring, Priya = customer comms. Adding owners to ticket. :white_check_mark:

Samir (Oncall): I'll keep this thread updated every 10m until stable.
_meta: generated for dataset: single slack thread representing cross-team customer escalation with ownership and mitigation steps
